verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
Alek t'a masanil heb' heyetchonhab' to ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik, haton juntzanh nok' tik syal he chi'ani:
Nok' sjax yanh cha xechanh yech.

Palta ha juntzanhxo nok' ol wal tik, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an nok', wach'chom sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok': Nok' camello sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok', ha nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' tejón, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', ha nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' niwak chich, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' chitam, wach'chom cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxpax swa'el nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Max yal he chi'an juntzanh nok' nok' chi', max yalpax heyaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', yowalil tze na'a to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley.
Haxo pax nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, ma t'a yoltak ha niwak ha', syal he chi'an nok' ay sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik.
Haxo pax nok' malaj sk'axil, malaj pax stuminal spatik, max yal-laj he chi'an nok'. Ha nok' chi' yajb'entak nok', wach'chom ha t'a yol ha' mar ma t'a yoltak ha' ay nok'.
Yujto yajb'entak nok', manh he chi nok', manh heyampax nok' chamnakxo.
Masanil nok' malaj sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik ay t'a yoltak ha', yajb'entakokab' yaj nok' t'a yol he sat.
Hanheja' pax t'a skal nok' much, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an juntzanh nok' ol wal tik, yujto manh wach'ok nok': Icha nok' t'iw, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano yet' masanil makanhil nok' xulem chi',
yet' masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' avestruz, nok' niwak tonton, nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' kujub', nok' kormorán, nok' ibis,
nok' pech, nok' julum chay, nok' ostok,
nok' cigüeña yet' masanil makanhil nok' garza yet' nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Hanhejtona' pax masanil nok' kotak nok' tz'ek' jenhenhok t'a jun petanhil sb'ey t'a sat lu'um, yajb'entakokab' nok' t'a yol he sat.
Haxo pax tato ha nok' ay yip yok sk'e tz'itnajok, wach'chom sjenhwi nok', sb'eypax nok' t'a sat lu'um, syal schiji nok'.
Ha t'a skal nok' chi' syal he chi'an smasanil makanhil nok' k'ulub', nok' niwak k'ulub' yet' nok' chil.
Haxo masanil juntzanhxo nok' kotakil nok' tz'ek' jenhenhok, ma tz'ek' t'a sat lu'um tik, yowalil tzeyaj nok'.

Tato tze yam juntzanh nok' nok' swal tik ayik chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tzex ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi. Masanil nok' nok' ay yech palta manh chaxechanhoklaj, max sjaxpax yanh, ha juntzanh nok' chi' nachajokab' el heyu'uj to manh wach'ok nok'. Yalnhej tas nok'al to chanhe' yok palta tzijtum yech mokab' wach'ok nok' t'a yol he sat. Yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman junok nok' nok' chi' tato chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley. Icha pax chi' junok mach tz'ik'ancha'anh nok' chamnak nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi. Manh wach'ok juntzanh nok' chi' icha yalan ley.

Haxo masanil nok' nok' tz'ek' t'a sat lu'um, nachajokab' el heyu'uj to max yal schiji juntzanh nok' tik: Icha nok' k'uxum boton, nok' ch'o'ow, nok' k'ok'on yet' masanil makanhil nok' pajtza' yet' masanil makanhil nok' tz'ek' nhernhonok ma tz'ek' jachjonok: Haton nok' ayin, nok' lagarto, nok' patix yet' nok' tzalajk'ab'.

Ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok', ha juntzanh nok' tik, nachajokab' el heyu'uj to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.

K'inalok ay junok tas b'aj tz'em nok' chamnak nok' chi', ha jun chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley: Wach'chom ha junok te te', junok pichul, junok tz'u'um, junok koxtal, ma junok yamk'ab' yik munlajel, tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, yowalil slab'chajem t'a skal ha ha'. Palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani, masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi, ichato chi' wach' tz'ajkani.
Tato tz'em junok nok' nok' chi' t'a yol junok lum chen ayik toxo ix cham nok', ha tas ayem t'a yol lum chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, haxo jun chen chi', yowalil smak'jipoj lu'um.
Yalnhej tas chib'il wa'ilal yet' yal ayem t'a yol jun chen chi', ma uk'em, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yuj chi' tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok tasi, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, wach'chom ha junok horno, ma junok yet'tal b'aj tz'och k'ak', yowalil spojji'eli. Ha jun yamk'ab' chi' manhxo wach'ok icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manhxo wach'ok pax t'a yol he sat.
Palta ha sjaj ha ha', ma ha' uk'b'ila' wach'chom tz'em nok' chamnak nok' t'a yol ha', wach'nhej yaj ha', anhej jun mach tz'ik'ank'eta nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yol ha' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
K'inalok tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok makan inhat tz'awchaji, ha jun makan inhat chi' max ixtaxel-laj.
Palta tato ha jun makan inhat lab'anxo, tz'em junok chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, ha juntzanh inhat chi' manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkani.
K'inalok scham junok nok' nok' to schiji, ha mach syaman nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'ikanemi.

Ha mach schi'an sb'ak'chil nok' chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'ikanemi. Ha mach tz'ik'anelta junok chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'i'emi.
Manh he chi juntzanh nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, yujto manh wach'ok nok'.

Masanil nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, wach'chom nok' sb'ey yet' schanhil yok, ma nok' tzijtum yok, masanil juntzanh nok' chi' manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manh he chi nok'.
Manh he ju'el he b'a ha hex tik yuj nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', yujto manh wach'ok tzex ajkan yuj nok'.
Ha hin ton Jehová he Diosal hin, yuj chi' b'esekel he b'a t'a juntzanh manh wach'ok chi', yujto wach' hinnhej, yuj chi' te max yal heyixtanb'at he b'a yet' juntzanh nok' chi'.
Ha hin Jehová hin, ix hex wik'elta t'a Egipto, he Diosal hin, yuj chi' te wach'okab'nhej tzeyutej he b'a yujto wach' hinnhej.
Haton wal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil nok' nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha' yet' masanil nok' tz'ek' jachachok t'a sat lu'um tik, swal t'ayex
yik wach' snachajel heyu'uj b'ajtil ay nok' wach' syal schiji yet' nok' manh wach'ok max yal schiji, xchi Jehová, xe chi.
